about: Word table the story lines were composed from. us: hand-written American Misaki entries (Escape the Cave entries reused). gb: British entries, made from the American ones by written rules plus hand-written exceptions. Keys word|tag mark a second pronunciation (read|past, close|adj, used|hab, wind|verb, wound|verb, bow|bend); letter:x is a letter said on its own. Special rules: the before a vowel = ði, to before a vowel = tʊ.
